sections.title: Leading and Managing Teams
sections.description: Learn to build, structure, and run teams for the full range of work they do – from decision-making to coordination to creating creative synergy and efficiencies. Through a series of dynamic immersions in trading floors, factories, military conflicts, natural disasters, and fabrication mock-ups, you will develop a visceral and memorable understanding of what teams need to thrive and how to avoid the predictable forces that derail them. This course is built to change how you engage and lead teams for the rest of your academic and professional career.
